text: Meeting deadlines can feel stressful, but with the right approach, it becomes manageable. The first step is effective time management. Break your project into smaller tasks and set mini-deadlines for each one. Next, practice prioritization by identifying which tasks are most important or time-sensitive, and tackle those first. Scope management is also crucial—if a project seems too large, be realistic about what you can achieve and adjust your plan accordingly. Finally, maintain clear communication. If you foresee a delay, inform your team or supervisor early. This builds trust and allows for adjustments before the deadline arrives, reducing last-minute panic.
